verdict.label: PURNEA
verdict.reasoning: IATA PXN, new_airport classification, and single-airport-city determination are all correct and confirmed by multiple sources (Wikipedia, IndiGo directory, Cleartrip, Flightradar24). Airport opened 15 September 2025. No second airport in Purnia. However, the window is wrong for this specific label. DGCA data shows two distinct label strings: "PURNIA AIRPORT" (2025-09 through 2025-11) and "PURNEA" (2025-12 onwards). The label "PURNEA" first appears in DGCA data in 2025-12, not 2025-09. The original evidence itself states "DGCA data appears from 2025-12," which correctly identifies the first appearance of "PURNEA" but then contradictorily sets the window to 2025-09 (the airport inauguration date). Setting valid_from=2025-09 on the "PURNEA" label assigns a window that predates this label's actual DGCA use; the 2025-09 to 2025-11 period is covered by the distinct "PURNIA AIRPORT" label, which needs its own separate entry.
verdict.corrected_window: valid_from: 2025-12 (first DGCA appearance of label "PURNEA"); "PURNIA AIRPORT" is a separate label covering 2025-09 to 2025-11 and needs its own mapping entry to PXN

verdict.label: LUDHIANA
verdict.reasoning: The label "LUDHIANA" spans two physically distinct airports: LUH (Sahnewal, ~6km from city) for 2017-09 through 2025-09, and HWR (Halwara International, ~25km from city) from 2026-02 onward. Evidence from CSV is unambiguous: (1) LUH final rows are 2025-09 LUDHIANA-HINDON at 17/27 pax (FlyBig UDAN 19-seater); LUH had zero commercial ops after ~2025-09-27 per news sources. (2) HWR was inaugurated 2026-02-01 by PM Modi; IATA code HWR confirmed. (3) The 2026-05 DELHI-LUDHIANA row shows 1708/1896 pax — magnitude 10-100x the final LUH UDAN operations, consistent only with HWR. The original decision correctly identifies new_airport but assigns LUH as the canonical key because "the bulk of the data (2017-2025)" is there — this is defensible for historical attribution but wrong as a forward-looking canonical key. LUH is permanently decommissioned; all future "LUDHIANA" DGCA entries will be HWR. Corrected canonical key is HWR. The pre-2026 data at LUH should ideally be a separate entry (LUH, 2017-09 to 2025-09).
verdict.corrected_window: HWR valid_from=2026-02; LUH valid 2017-09..2025-09 (separate entry needed)
